sections.contenu_markdown: A question with two question marks in disguise ('What...? Why?') always expects two separate pieces of information in the answer.

items: Locating factual information in a passage

sections.contenu_markdown: When a question combines two sub-questions (commonly 'what' and 'why'), identify and answer each part separately and explicitly, since each part is usually graded independently.

sections.enonce_markdown: Answer: 'What should you do whenever you notice cases of infection? Why?'

etapes.resultat_markdown: For proper diagnosis and effective treatment

etapes.action: Combine both into one full answer
etapes.resultat_markdown: Report to hospital, so that... diagnosis and treatment

sections.conclusion_markdown: Both the action and its justification are given explicitly.

items.erreur_markdown: Answering only the 'what' part and forgetting the 'why' part.
items.pourquoi_faux: Each part of a two-part question is usually allocated its own share of the marks; omitting one loses those marks even if the rest is correct.
items.correction_markdown: Always check a question for hidden multiple parts (what/why, who/how) and answer each one explicitly.

items.enonce_markdown: Answer a two-part question: 'What should students do before an exam? Why?' (based on a passage recommending revision to succeed).
items.solution_markdown: Students should revise their lessons regularly, so that they can succeed in their exams.
